title_en: Tirana, apartment for sale 2+1+Balcony Floor 3, 114 m² €153,000 (coconut road)
description_en: Splendor Residence is an ambitious project located in the Porcelan area, just a few meters from the main road. The interior space of the residential complex creates micro green spaces, basketball half-courts, children's playgrounds, 2 green flower gardens and recreational spaces around them. We have for sale an apartment 2+1+2 bathrooms. The apartment has a total area of ​​114 m2, of which 91.85 m2 is net internal area. It is organized in a large living room, two bedrooms, two toilets and a balcony. Price: €153,000.
